Verse 1.1 [Question of the Sages]

Verse 1.2

Sanskrit text, Unicode transliteration and English translation by Ganganath Jha:

मनुमेकाग्रमासीनमभिगम्य महर्षयः । प्रतिपूज्य यथान्यायमिदं वचनमब्रुवन्

manum ekāgram āsīnam abhigamya maharṣayaḥ

English translation:

The great sages approached Manu, who was seated with a collected mind, and, having duly worshipped him, spoke as follows.

Medhātithi's commentary (manubhāṣya):

Salutation to the Supreme Brahman! His real character can be known only from the Vedānta texts.

Explanatory notes by Ganganath Jha

'Pratipūjya'—has been taken by Kullūka to mean also 'after mutual salutations'.

Comparative notes by various authors

Cf. Vīramitrodaya, p. 3.
